The server is unencrypted and has no login. Anyone on the same network can connect and read the sensors you allow below. Only use it on networks you trust.
While the server runs, any device on your network can connect without a password and read your allowed sensors. Traffic isn\'t encrypted. Use it only on networks you trust, or over USB.

string-array.name: vendor_samsung_steps
string-array.item: Settings › Apps › phonetopc › Battery: choose Unrestricted.
Settings › Battery › Background usage limits: make sure phonetopc isn\'t in Sleeping apps or Deep sleeping apps.
In the same screen, add phonetopc to Never sleeping apps.

string-array.name: vendor_xiaomi_steps
string-array.item: Settings › Apps › Manage apps › phonetopc: turn on Autostart.
In the same screen, Battery saver: choose No restrictions.
Open Recents, long-press phonetopc and tap the lock icon.

string-array.name: vendor_oneplus_steps
string-array.item: Settings › Battery › Battery optimization: set phonetopc to Don\'t optimize.
Settings › Apps › phonetopc › Battery usage: allow background activity.
Open Recents and lock phonetopc so it isn\'t cleared.

string-array.name: vendor_huawei_steps
string-array.item: Settings › Battery › App launch: turn off Manage automatically for phonetopc.
Allow Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.
Open Recents and lock phonetopc so it isn\'t cleared.

string-array.name: vendor_generic_steps
string-array.item: Allow unrestricted battery use with the button above.
Look up your phone\'s brand on dontkillmyapp.com for extra steps.

resources.string: A quiet notification shows when a PC is connected and lets you pause or stop at any time.
To keep data flowing while the screen is off, allow phonetopc to run without battery restrictions. It only uses sensors while a PC asks for them.
%1$s there are a few extra steps. You\'ll find them in Settings.
Next, pair your PC: run phonetopc pair on it and open the Pair tab here. Then start the server on the home screen.
